claim: Scene-level cloud cover does not predict whether the corridor windows are readable. A 1.6% scene leaves the median window 21% clear.
why_it_matters: Independent replication, in a different country and terrain, of the Jeju v8 finding that scene cloud is the wrong selection variable (a 1.0% scene left 0/12 sites readable). Selection must be made on per-site SCL, not on the scene header.

method.readable_definition: SCL in {4,5,6,7}, read at each window's UTM bounds, 64x64
method.note: readability is measured at the window, never inferred from eo:cloud_cover

reading: 2026-09-28 is the day the Narayani peaked at Devghat and the only near-clear scene of the period. Even so, only 12 of 56 windows reach 80% readability, so an optical event pair for the late-September flood cannot be built at the source corridor. Radar remains the only path, which is what the sealed radar contracts already assume.
limits: Readability is not usability: a window can be SCL-clear and still be unusable for a pair if its partner date is not. This measures one side only.
